# Long Content Stress Fixtures

These development-only strings support 009.10 responsive and interaction hardening. They are not public copy and must not be pasted into production routes.

Use one fixture at a time in a local branch or browser editing tool, then revert the test text.

## Fixtures

- Long hero H1: `The First Chapter Begins in Abuja With A Deliberately Long Festival Preview Title That Must Wrap Naturally`
- Long section heading: `A Deliberately Long Section Heading Used To Confirm Safe Wrapping Across Narrow Viewports`
- Long CTA label: `Explore The Complete Abuja Preview Experience Without Clipping`
- Long Festival supporting statement: `Power, Identity and the Right to Self-Definition Across Names, Memory, Language and Cultural Imagination`
- Long chapter label: `07 — Books, Merchandise, Publishing Conversations and Visitor Takeaways`
- Long event venue value: `To be confirmed by the organizers with a deliberately long venue placeholder value`
- Long FAQ question: `What should visitors know if the final schedule, access process, venue entrance details and registration method are still awaiting organizer approval?`
- Long FAQ answer: `Organizer-approved practical guidance will be added after confirmation. This deliberately long answer verifies that native disclosure content expands naturally without clipping, overlap or fixed-height panel constraints.`
- Long media caption: `Placeholder caption for approved festival media with extended descriptive text that must remain attached to the media frame and wrap safely.`
- Long media credit: `Image credit pending organizer approval from a deliberately long organization or contributor name.`
- Long footer link: `Festival Information Pending Organizer Review`
- Long partner name: `Partner Name Pending Organizer Approval With Extended Legal Name`
- Long registration note: `Registration details will be confirmed by the organizers after the final destination, data collection requirements and public communication language are approved.`

## Pass Criteria

- Text wraps naturally without horizontal scrolling.
- Focus outlines remain visible around edited links and controls.
- No essential text is clipped, overlapped, hidden, or replaced by ellipsis.
- Layouts remain readable at 1440, 1280, 1024, 769, 768, 767, 376, 375, 374, 321, and 320px.
